objection_resolutions.resolution: Source contracts show deinit is void; savedataClone returns zero both for no data and several failures, allocates without an explicit null check before VFileFromMemory, and closes its temporary VFile without consuming that close result; savedataRestore returns the load result only on writeback, while the mask path returns its initialized true value. This bounds what these core methods can report, without inferring downstream caller behavior.

negative_test_evidence.reason: The runner does not compile src/gba/core.c or call the mCore savedataClone/savedataRestore methods.

objection_resolutions.remaining: Trace and test actual mCore consumers, allocation/constructor and close/error behavior; distinguish no-save from failure at the consumer boundary.

objection_resolutions.resolution: The GBA factory returns an mCore pointer; its registered deinit has a void contract and calls ARMDeinit then GBADestroy before freeing the board. The GBA declaration likewise exposes void GBADestroy. This identifies the source-level error-reporting boundary, not whether all teardown effects have completed durably.

negative_test_evidence.reason: The host fixture executes extracted cleanup/frame functions and a real POSIX VFileFD; it does not initialize or deinitialize the full mCore/GBA.

objection_resolutions.remaining: Complete the external embedder/frontend caller graph and destruction tests before assessing shutdown-save success.

objection_resolutions.resolution: The pinned declarations place dirty state, active and real VFiles, writeback masking, and an RTC time/control/latch buffer in savedata state, and declare RTC read/write plus save-state serialize/deserialize methods. Declarations alone do not specify implementation effects or durable RTC handling.

negative_test_evidence.reason: The fixture replaces GBASavedataRTCWrite with a counter stub and does not compile the serializer or exercise RTC data, save-state round trips, restart, or persistence.

objection_resolutions.remaining: Trace RTC and serialization implementations and their consumers; add native round-trip/restart evidence before resolving state-persistence semantics.

objection_resolutions.resolution: The helper clears dirty state and returns true only after a strict greater-than-15-frame age; it exposes no VFile result. The PR13 host fixture executes this pinned helper with the original GBASavedataClean and GBAFrameEnded bodies, injects Linux msync(MS_ASYNC) failure, and observes cleared dirty state, no RTC-write call, and a savedataUpdated callback. The callback is therefore not a source-level proof of sync success.

negative_test_evidence.reason: This is a Linux host source-extracted fixture with injected msync failure, not a full mGBA runtime, cold restart, user-facing frontend, or physical Flash test.

objection_resolutions.remaining: Determine whether caller notification and dirty-state consumption are acceptable across actual runtime and VFile configurations; test persistence/retry semantics beyond the host fixture.

objection_resolutions.resolution: All six complete files carry the MPL-2.0 notice in their leading lines and their Git blobs, full-file byte hashes, and dossier rows are bound below. The GBA and core headers include or embed additional internal/public types; this six-file subset is not a complete transitive compile/runtime dependency closure and implies no combined-distribution licensing conclusion.
